text: Action-ka waa ujeedda. Waa waxa attacker-ku rabo. Haddii action-ku aanu beddelin state, attacker-ku kama faa'iidaysto. Wuxuu rabaa impact. Wuxuu rabaa side effect. Wuxuu rabaa wax beddela.

heading: Tiirka 2: Authentication Waa Cookie-Based

heading: Tiirka 3: Ma Jiro Token Sir Ah (Ama Waa La Jabin Karaa)

Token wuu jiraa laakiin lagu xaqiijiyay method gaar ah — Haa, CSRF wuu dhacaa (method override). Token wuu jiraa laakiin lagu xaqiijiyay presence — Haa, CSRF wuu dhacaa (tirtir token). Token wuu jiraa laakiin lagu xaqiijiyay cookie — Haa, CSRF wuu dhacaa (CRLF injection). Token wuu  jiraa oo si sax ah loo xaqiijiyay — Maya, CSRF ma dhaco.

heading: Tiirka 3: Ma Jiro Token Sir Ah (Ama Waa La Jabin Karaa)
text: Token-ku waa caqabad. Waa obstacle. Waa defense. Haddii token-ku maqan yahay ama la jabsan karo, attacker-ku wuu ka gudbaa. Haddii token-ku adag yahay, attacker-ku ma gudbi karo.

heading: Tiirka 3: Ma Jiro Token Sir Ah (Ama Waa La Jabin Karaa)
